design.eventPoolingPolicy: Replay-level estimates are primary. Event pooling is used only for descriptive diagnostics such as aggregate aim convention.
design.frozenPriorPolicy: Discovery-replay thresholds and angle conventions are evaluated directly before independent replay-specific best fits are considered.

interpretationGuide.frozenVsBestFit: High frozen-threshold performance is stronger replication evidence than merely recovering a similar best-fitting threshold.
interpretationGuide.replayUnit: Thousands of events within one replay improve precision inside that replay but do not increase the number of independent replication units.
interpretationGuide.strictMatching: Economic analyses use mutually unique death-activation candidate pairs to minimize false source attribution.
interpretationGuide.isolatedEconomy: Reward and recipient analyses require isolated exact-tick payout cases to reduce contamination from simultaneous unrelated currency gains.
interpretationGuide.rewardScaling: Ordinary reward scaling is estimated primarily from leading-team pre-35-minute cases to avoid comeback and late Super-Trooper confounds.
interpretationGuide.vacuum: Vacuum geometry uses 4-Hz player-state positions and therefore should not be interpreted as an exact engine-radius measurement.
interpretationGuide.aim: Aim replication uses successful CItemXP damage as a positive-control attack event and compares the near-impact window with a temporally distant placebo window.

nextStage.ifStrong: Promote replicated foundational telemetry contracts from single-replay operational status to cross-replay validated status and proceed toward behavioral opportunity-feature construction.
nextStage.ifMixed: Investigate only the specific non-replicating contract instead of reopening the entire discovery pipeline.
